title: About demo
body:
Thank you for the great demos! I have two questions:

1. Was the pre-trained model specifically trained for these demos, or was it trained on previous 3D scenes?

2. Even in a simple 2D scenario like demo II, the agent sometimes crashes into obstacles (`range_matrix[v0_idx].min() == 0.0`). How can the performance be further improved?
I've tried increasing the number of LiDAR beams to improve perception accuracy, enlarging the neural network, and modifying the reward function. However, none of these attempts seemed to work—perhaps I didn’t apply them correctly. Could you provide some specific suggestions or guidance?

Looking forward to your insights!
author: Bruce-Si

comments.body:
1. All pretrained model in this repo are exactly the same (No specific tuning for different robot or environments).
2. 0 distance is not considered a crash for a mass point. You can easily add a safety distance margin to the network input for a real robot with size (check ros1/ros2 deployment map size inflation.

Because the model is pre-trained in Isaac Sim, so it is not available to directly change the number of beams or modify the neural network. Also, based on my training experience, even training in purely static environment in Isaac Sim can lead to 95+% success rate which cannot ganrantee 100% of safety. However, we have implemented a conservative safety shield to prevent servere collision happen in the ros1/ros2 deployment.

title: In ROS1 Deployment, "/mavros/local_position/odom" topic can not be subscribed when I launch navigation.py
body: navigation.py can not subscribe the topic /mavros/local_position/odom.  So the terminal continuously shows the information " [nav-ros]:Wait for robot odom".   I notice that in the ROS package uav_navigation, it's the px4_start.launch file that publishes the mavros topic instead of the start.launch. Does that mean I should install the px4 dependencies and run the px4_start.launch to reproduce your work? Thanks and looking forwards to your reply.
author: JulienZHENG

comments.body: The navigation by default should subscribe to CERLAB/quacopter/odom and subscribe to mavros/local_position/pose after manually modifying the px4 option in the launch file. Please make sure you run the correct launch file.

title: "test_navigation" should be replaced by "navigation_runner" ROS package??
